mission_prompt: Investigate the APT enterprise intrusion in D:\Security-logs-test\attack-cases-benchmark\case-5-dns-tunneling-data-exfiltration\raw-logs. Reconstruct the full attack kill chain across authentication logs, process executions, and network flows. Extract all C2 indicators of compromise (IOCs), map MITRE ATT&CK techniques, and generate automated containment policies.

units.description: List all files and subdirectories under the specified raw‑logs path to identify authentication, process, and network log files.

Using the file list from t1, read each log file (e.g., auth.log, proc.log, netflow.log). Extract structured events: timestamps, user accounts, process IDs, command lines, source/destination IPs, DNS queries, and payload sizes.

units.task_name: Extract C2 Indicators and Map MITRE ATT&CK Techniques
units.description: Analyze the parsed datasets to identify suspicious patterns: repeated DNS queries to uncommon domains, anomalous process chains, lateral movement indicators. Extract IOCs (domains, IPs, file hashes, registry keys) and map each to relevant ATT&CK techniques using threat_intel and data_analysis.

Based on the IOC table from t3, produce containment rules for firewall/IDS and endpoint protection: block malicious domains/IPs, quarantine suspicious processes, and alert on future DNS tunneling patterns. Format policies in a machine‑readable format (e.g., JSON or YAML) suitable for deployment.
